column1: # THE SHRINKING WORKLIST (design-marathi §3.3): every text a person sees on the phone that is not keyed yet.
#   text  the literal's body exactly as written between its quotes (a real tab or newline as \t / \n)
# Seeded 27 Oct 2026 (slice 1a, which keys nothing) from the readers' inventory: the 1,019 Kotlin rows of :app
# and the 691 shown rows of :pano, 1,516 distinct (file, text) rows. Every one was found in its file by
# LiteralScan, and LiteralScan found no UI-position text outside them. (The AndroidManifest label, the
# product name, is not Kotlin and is not scanned.)
# Each slice REMOVES the rows it keys. I18nLiteralTest fails on a shown literal missing from here (a), on a row
# whose text is gone from its file -- prune it (c) -- and on a row for a file listed in ported.txt (d). When it
# is empty and ported.txt names every source, any new shown literal fails CI, and the भाषा · Language row may show.
# The :camera rows (X3Bridge.kt: the X3's connect and capture messages, shown on the capture sheet and in the
# result banner) were added by the slice 1a review, 27 Oct 2026, when :camera joined the scanned modules.
# Slice 1b (27 Oct 2026) removed the settings drawer's 23 rows: 19 keyed (the group titles, the lines, and the
# values "nothing yet", "all sent", "$queued waiting", TreeShell's "no server set") and 4 marked `// text:value`
# (ImageMeter, DISTO D2, mm · ft-in, mm). "Server", "not set" and "Sign out" stay: they are still shown unkeyed
# elsewhere in MainActivity.kt. "Not signed in" stays until the v61c card carries it.
# Slice 1c (27 Oct 2026) removed the project list's rows -- BrowseScreens, HomeScreens, Crumbs, the Clients title
# and crumbs, the plural() words (now Tx's pl_* accessors) and the lastResult / busy messages that have prototype
# keys -- and marked Crumbs' two glyphs `// text:value`. Its review (same day) keyed two texts the slice had
# missed because the phone splits their literal with `+`: the Clients empty state (app.no_clients_yet_go) and
# the keep-faces banner (app.msg.x_pictures_saved_x), so the keyed lastResult / busy messages are 20, at 21 sites. The
# slice ADDED one row: MainActivity's "$unsent waiting", the Sync queue's subtitle, "3 waitings". The prototype
# draws that same subtitle as plural(unsent(),'waiting') (v53 app.js:565, unchanged in v61b), so the phone already
# matches it byte for byte; it has no whole key at that site (app.x_waiting is the drawer's Sync-now value,
# app.js:215, and app.waiting a fragment), so it waits for a key on the v61c card, not for decision 5.
# BrowseScreens' "SITE" badge stays too: the prototype draws it as an unkeyed literal, and noun.site is "site".
# Port 61c slice PL (3 Nov 2026) ported BrowseScreens.kt and QuoteStage.kt and removed their 36 rows: "SITE" and "PRJ" are
# marked `// text:value` (the prototype's own unkeyed badges); the old QUOTE STAGE line's texts left with the code.
# Its review (same day) removed 7 more: Catalogue's dateRange and statusLabel words (from, due, offline, done, cancelled,
# active), keyed through app.from_x, app.due_x and the pill's four keys, and MainActivity's top bar, whose job type is
# drawn through Masters.job now, as BrowseScreens draws the room, job type and site type through Masters.
